protocol: Test No. 2 at Halle-Dölau. The case collapsed near the end of the planned ten-minute stay at 12,000 m.
outcome_window: Initial collapse at altitude, apparent improvement during descent and later loss of consciousness and pulmonary edema. Follow-up duration unavailable.
locator: Hornberger p. 364 (Michigan scan 376) and Becker-Freyseng p. 1077 (scan 439)
note: This is one shared episode. Hornberger cites Becker-Freyseng and Kellersmann and considers central circulatory failure after decompression possible. The report does not establish a definitive modern DCS or AGE diagnosis. The collapse occurred in 1943 and predates the July 1944 to April 1945 platoon records.
